title: Lilac Papillon Ring
category: Ring (statement butterfly cocktail ring, 2-layer front, fixed size, worn on the middle finger)
metal: 18k gold tone (PVD 18K gold coating, per the description), bright high-polish warm yellow on rims, body bar, outline frame and shank; never rose, orange or brassy. The pave bed under the lilac stones is tinted lilac, so the wing faces read lavender edge to edge with tiny 18k gold tone grain beads between the stones.
lock: A ring in 18k gold tone, high polish: 1 slim plain shank under a 2-layer butterfly 24mm across. On top, 1 solid 4-wing butterfly, 18mm wide, each wing in a raised polished rim, filled with dense pale lavender-lilac micro pave (about 150 stones), 1 plain polished body bar, 0 antennae. Behind it, 1 larger openwork butterfly outline in 1 row of about 48 tiny clear round stones. The clear-stone outline must stay a separate open frame offset behind the lilac wings with see-through gaps between them, never filled in, never a halo hugging the wing edges, never merged into one butterfly.
morph: The 2-layer build. Image models fuse the clear-stone outline into the lilac wings (a pave halo hugging each wing edge, or the 4 open windows filled with stones or metal), or drop it and leave one plain butterfly. The outline's 4 lobes are irregular, not a neat offset copy: the 2 upper lobes are squarish wavy flags that stick out sideways past the upper lilac wings, the 2 lower lobes are pointed and hang below the lower wings. Second risks: the lilac drifts to pink, deep purple or amethyst, or turns into flat enamel or a few large stones; antennae, a head or a stone-set body get added; 2 or 6 wings; the shank thickens or splits; rose-gold drift (worn 03 already reads rosier under skin light). Third: scale inflation; earlier ads drew it at about 32mm across two fingers (lilac-papillon-ring-worn-feed) and at 2x a live butterfly (crazy13), against a true 24mm.
sizeMm: Listed (size-guide image in the listing and in the description): butterfly 18mm wide, 24mm wide with its outline, give or take 1mm. Note: size-cards/cards.json says this figure came from Edition One scale plus the macro's proportion, not a supplier spec sheet. Estimated from macro 01 by the same proportion: lilac butterfly about 19mm tall, whole front about 22mm tall; shank about 2 to 2.5mm wide. Ring size is not listed anywhere and the piece is not tagged Adjustable (the band looks closed). Worn (03, 05): on the middle finger the wingspan runs across the finger with the body bar along it, covering the finger and overhanging about a third of a finger on each side (about 1.4 finger widths), never two full fingers. Referents: the lilac butterfly is about a thumbnail wide; with its outline about a 2-rupee coin (23mm); in 04 it is a little wider than a green cardamom pod is long.
copyNotes: Use: 'butterfly', 'papillon' (French for butterfly), 'titli', 'lilac' or 'lavender' stones, 'micro pave', 'clear stones', 'openwork outline', '18k gold tone', 'PVD 18K gold coating' (a material fact from the description), 'statement ring', 'middle finger', 'Pre-order', price Rs 1,199. Avoid: claims of any kind, because the piece has no Waterproof, Tarnish Free or Hypoallergenic tag ('anti-tarnish', 'stands up to sweat' and 'keeps its colour' are in the description but are colour-hold claims the house rule bans); 'diamond', 'amethyst', 'CZ' or 'cubic zirconia' (the listing never names the stones), 'enamel'; 'real' or 'solid gold' and bare 'gold' (so never 'Spot the real one', the crazy13 breach); 'adjustable' or a ring size (none listed); 'in stock' or 'ships today' (it is tagged pre-order, so the plan's 'Every piece here is in stock.' line does not fit this card); 'Edition One' or 'KAVNAR' (internal tags); the stale prices Rs 1,299 and Rs 1,899 from earlier research.
story: A butterfly, twice: a solid lilac butterfly landed on a sparkling ghost of itself, like the after-image of wings mid-beat, so it looks in motion while standing still. Lavender on warm 18k gold tone is soft, not loud, but at 24mm it is a true statement ring. It rhymes with: 'pet mein titliyan' (butterflies in the stomach: a first date, a proposal, results day), titli, jacaranda season (lilac trees in Bengaluru and Hyderabad), lilac roses (listing 06), a lavender lehenga or saree at a sangeet or mehendi, 90s butterfly hair clips (Y2K nostalgia), 'social butterfly', metamorphosis and a new chapter (new job, graduation, glow-up), elaichi chai (the cardamom-pod scale shot). Strongest ad mechanics: the real butterfly versus the ring at honest 24mm scale, the double outline as motion, macro on the lilac pave, a lilac-on-lilac monochrome set.
variants: One variant only: Default Title, 18k gold tone with lilac and clear stones, stock 20, Rs 1,199, tagged pre-order. Every ring photo shows it. Listing media, in order: 01 supplier macro straight on, on a cream plaster cube (clearest whole construction: both layers, all 4 open windows, body bar, shank behind); 02 supplier three-quarter on the cube (shows the layering depth and the slim plain shank); 03 worn on the middle finger, hand on the chest, mustard satin slip (scale; no glint); 04 on a cube beside a green cardamom pod (scale, but a pasted 4-point star glint on the right wing); 05 worn, hand on ivory linen (scale; star glint on the right wing tip); 06 set in the heart of a lilac rose (top view); 07 on a brass-rimmed mirror with its reflection (star glint); 08 the blush Naira gift box, no ring; 09 the size guide (text overlays, never a ref). The description's embedded size guide is the same file as 09 and was not kept as a separate 10. 03 to 07 are later studio or generated lifestyle shots; 01 and 02 (SKU WR11674B2) are the construction authority. Show 01 as reference 1 and 03 as reference 2. No earlier media ids exist in ads-500 products.md for this handle, so both were imported fresh from their Shopify CDN URLs.
